scope: Dimension 2 (document / contract family). Descriptive and source-anchored; the two frozen documents are both vendor-published SLAs, so this library cannot evidence cross-family transfer. Families without examples are placeholders, not learned categories.

SERVICE_LEVEL_AGREEMENT.criteria: A document, or an appendix to another agreement, whose primary content is a measurable service-level commitment, a metric definition, exclusions and a credit or remedy procedure.

feature_evidence: GitHub commits to maintain at least 99.9% Uptime
examples.note: Standard published terms; not a signed agreement.
Archived published terms; explicitly not the current version; not a signed agreement.

counterexamples.source: GH-TERMS-UPDATES (packet G5 of the V1 corpus)
counterexamples.reason: A vendor change notice about which SLA version applies; it is not itself an agreement.
counterexamples.evidence_anchor: This June 2026 version of the GitHub SLA will apply to new customers and renewals

SERVICE_LEVEL_AGREEMENT.mixed_or_appended: Both examples incorporate or are incorporated into a master agreement that is not available (see legal_context records). Treat the family as nested inside an unavailable parent agreement.

lineage.reason: two source-anchored examples and one counterexample from frozen packets

MASTER_SERVICES_AGREEMENT.criteria: Framework agreement under which services are ordered and which carries governing law, liability and term provisions.
MASTER_SERVICES_AGREEMENT.note: PLACEHOLDER_NO_EVIDENCE: referenced by both SLAs as 'the Agreement' but unavailable.

FINANCING_AGREEMENT.criteria: Agreement whose primary content is lending, repayment, security and covenants.

EMPLOYMENT_AGREEMENT.criteria: Agreement whose primary content is an employment relationship, remuneration and duties.

LICENSING_AGREEMENT.criteria: Agreement whose primary content is a grant of rights to use intellectual property or software.

DATA_PROCESSING_ADDENDUM.criteria: Addendum governing personal-data processing roles, instructions and safeguards.

OTHER_UNKNOWN.criteria: No family can be assigned from the available evidence.

lineage.reason: initial family definitions; only SERVICE_LEVEL_AGREEMENT has evidence
